facts.text: Audrey offered to help Andrew find a suitable place for his new furry friend.

evidence.quote: I'm here to support! Email me your criterias so I can help you find a great spot for your furry friend.
Oof, Hang in there, you'll find the perfect place for you and your new furry friend.
